# apple_alternative_distribution_key (Resource)

Adds the public half of an alternative distribution key, which an alternative marketplace or web distribution uses to verify installs. Without `app_id` the key applies to every alternative distribution app of the account; with it, to one app. A key can't change: changing an attribute replaces it. Import it by ID, or with `<app_id>/<id>` for an app's key, because App Store Connect doesn't report the app of a key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The key for every alternative distribution app of the account.
resource "apple_alternative_distribution_key" "account" {
  public_key = file("${path.module}/alternative-distribution-public-key.pem")
}

# A key for one app.
resource "apple_alternative_distribution_key" "app" {
  app_id     = data.apple_app.example.id
  public_key = file("${path.module}/example-app-public-key.pem")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `public_key` (String) The public key. Changing it creates a new key.

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app the key is for. Unset means every app of the account. Changing it creates a new key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the alternative distribution key, which install verification tokens name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_alternative_distribution_key.account
  identity = {
    id = "6f8a0c2e-4b1d-4e3f-8a5c-7d9e0f1a2b3c"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the alternative distribution key.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The account's key, by ID.
terraform import apple_alternative_distribution_key.account 6f8a0c2e-4b1d-4e3f-8a5c-7d9e0f1a2b3c

# An app's key, by the app's ID and the key's ID.
terraform import apple_alternative_distribution_key.app 1234567890/9a0c2e4f-6b1d-4a3c-8e5f-0f1a2b3c4d5e
```
